headline: Who's That?
caption:
Dana White didn't seem to recognize top-5 heavyweight Alexander Volkov at the UFC 333 press conference.
Awkward or funny? 👇

When Volkov spoke up from the crowd in Abu Dhabi, White asked how he could help until Alexander Volkanovski pointed out who it was. Volkov faces Rizvan Kuniev on the UFC 333 main card Saturday.

🔥 Hot take: A top-5 heavyweight with 40 pro wins should never need an introduction.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
question: Awkward or funny?
